name: Kingdom of Kongo
notes: Traditional founding account: Lukeni lua Nimi, c. 1390 (alternative account names Nimi a Nzima of Mpemba Kasi and Nsaku Lau of Mbata) — a genealogical/oral-traditional date, not archaeologically fixed. First Portuguese contact 1483 (Diogo Cão). John K. Thornton's body of work is the standard modern academic history.
